description: PHP class 'sysinfo' providing system information functions for Linux, including OS details, hardware info, network, memory, and device data.

classes.name: sysinfo
classes.description: A PHP class that gathers and provides system information on Linux systems.

methods.name: sysinfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing system info, reading distro details from ini files.

methods.name: vhostname
methods.description: Returns the server's hostname or virtual host name.

methods.name: chostname
methods.description: Returns the canonical hostname of the system.

methods.name: ip_addr
methods.description: Returns the IP address of the system.

methods.name: users
methods.description: Returns the number of logged-in users.

methods.name: loadavg
methods.description: Returns system load averages, optionally with CPU bar.

methods.name: cpu_info
methods.description: Gathers CPU details such as model, speed, cache, and bogomips.

methods.name: sbus
methods.description: Placeholder for SBus device info (not implemented).

methods.name: memory
methods.description: Returns memory and swap usage details.

methods.name: distroicon
methods.description: Returns the icon associated with the distribution.
